blockers.issue: safe_text's third URL_TEXT alternative `(?<![\w.-])(?:[\w-]+\.)+[\w-]+(?:[/:?#][^\s<>\[\]"']*)?` uses `\w`, which in Python str patterns matches CJK ideographs. Any Chinese run that contains a single ASCII dot between word characters (version numbers, decimals, file names: `升级到2.0`, `耗时1.5秒`, `修改config.yaml`) is therefore matched as a 'domain' from the first CJK character after a non-word boundary to the end of the run, and the entire sentence fragment is replaced by `（链接已省略）`. This is not the documented 'dotted version-like token may be replaced'; it erases the whole fact text/goal for ordinary synthetic titles and excerpts, which contradicts 'readable Chinese meeting pack' and 'do not truncate facts'. Because the optional `[/:?#]...` tail is also swallowed and the bare-reference detector runs on `URL_TEXT.sub("", text)`, a `#N` that follows such a run is silently removed before detection, so the required bare-#12 ambiguity is NOT reported for that message. The same first alternative `[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:` also replaces ordinary `Word:` prefixes (`Fix: sync bug` -> `（链接已省略） sync bug`). Suggested fix: restrict the domain heuristic to ASCII labels with an alphabetic last label, e.g. `(?<![A-Za-z0-9.-])(?:[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.)+[A-Za-z]{2,}(?![A-Za-z0-9])(?:[/:?#][^\s<>\[\]"']*)?`, and make the scheme alternative require `://` or an explicit dangerous-scheme list (javascript, data, vbscript, file, mailto); add tests asserting benign Chinese text with ASCII dots survives display and that `#12` after such text still yields an ambiguity; update the doc line about dotted text accordingly.
blockers.reproduction: 1) In a copy of examples/meeting-preview.json set github[0].title to "虚构：依赖升级到2.0后测试通过" and run `python -m ostag.main meeting preview --input copy.json --format json`; the pr_merged fact `text` and the source `excerpt` become "虚构：（链接已省略） 完全虚构的本地演示记录。" (the full title after the colon is gone). Setting request.goal to "核实v2.0上线证据" yields goal == "（链接已省略）" (match starts at the first CJK char because the preceding char is not \w). 2) Set feishu[1].text to "虚构讨论：#12后升级到2.0再确认": URL_TEXT.sub strips "12后升级到2.0再确认" (lookbehind passes after '#'), leaving "虚构讨论：#", so `ambiguities` is empty and no unqualified_pr_reference is reported; the displayed fact text is "虚构讨论：\#（链接已省略）". Python check: `re.search(r'(?<![\w.-])(?:[\w-]+\.)+[\w-]+', '依赖升级到2.0后测试通过').group()` returns the whole string. 3) Set a title to "Fix: sync bug": rendered as "（链接已省略） sync bug".

Scope/grant simulation, half-open window on event_at (created_at/updated_at ignored), out-of-scope resource rejection before window filtering, single merge record per repo/PR, exact head check matching (repo+PR+ref, check_sha==head_sha==pr.head_sha), production deployment matching (repo+ref+sha==merge_sha+environment=='production', in-window only), release/commit/check never inferred as deployed, bare-#N ambiguity listing all selected repos, explicit-reference-only Feishu linking, deployment_unverified phrased as unknown, coverage manifest exactness, failed/denied partitions cannot carry records, needs_input=3 with partial output, and citation construction from frozen owner/repo plus typed IDs all appear correct in the code and consistent with the demo output.

In the leading-global-option path (`--dry-run meeting preview ...`), invalid arguments go through argparse's default error handler, so argv values are echoed to stderr (e.g. `invalid choice: 'private-secret'`), unlike the meeting-first path which uses run_preview_cli's generic message. This is argv, not fixture payload, so not treated as blocking, but the doc's exit-code-2 claim ('不回显输入') is only exact for the meeting-first form; either route the leading-option case through run_preview_cli too or narrow the doc wording.

The added scalar tests for request/mapping/grant/partitions pass, showing _keys and the reused from_dict validators raise ValueError/TypeError for those; `observed_at` being a non-string (e.g. 1, null, {}) is passed straight to freeze_meeting_scope as `now` and to _utc and is not covered by a test. Underscores in validated identifiers are still Markdown-escaped in the JSON projection (`feature_x` -> `feature\_x` for ref/environment/tag) while matching uses raw values. Safety of mapping-derived strings (repository full_name, chat_id) in Markdown relies on the existing ProjectMapping/MeetingRequest validators; full_name is interpolated into citation URLs and chat_id into `feishu:chat:<id>` resource IDs rendered raw in the sources and gaps lines. test_real_cli_json_markdown_and_installed_entrypoint still asserts an `ostag` console script beside sys.executable, coupling the suite to the validation venv layout; test_other_main_command_dispatch_is_preserved is an unmarked async test and depends on asyncio_mode=auto (passes per evidence).
